comparator.name: Theology
comparator.sourceNotes: The formally adopted 2026-2027 regulations define a 180-ECTS Theology bachelor and four variants: with or without Greek, each with or without the PThU trajectory. The PThU trajectory with Greek is selected under the broad-academic-identity rule because it combines both biblical source languages with biblical, systematic, historical, intercultural and practical theology, and the current public programme page identifies it as the most commonly chosen variant. In Year 2 the PThU rules replace the ordinary media/text choice with Psychology and Sociology of Religion and replace Religion and Politics with Dogmatics. Year 3 is the prescribed 30-ECTS PThU block plus a specialization, Thesis Seminar, Science Communication and thesis. Origins of Religion: Foundational Texts and their Transformations is selected as the first specialization in official order, independently of UCR fit.

routeSelection.basis: The generic registry target names the Theology bachelor but no variant. The PThU trajectory with Greek is the broadest current theological pathway: it preserves both Hebrew and Greek and adds practical, dogmatic, historical, biblical, intercultural and ethical theology. The public programme page also presents it as the most commonly chosen variant. This selection is based on the target programme's academic identity and is independent of UCR fit.

exception.reason: The selected Groningen pathway is defined by sustained disciplinary Theology: theology-specific concepts and methods; biblical Hebrew and Greek; the Hebrew Bible, New Testament and their exegesis; the history and thought of Christianity; practical and systematic theology; dogmatics; biblical, historical, intercultural and ethical theology; Islam and Judaism in theological context; a dedicated specialization; and a 10-ECTS Theology thesis. UCR offers adjacent philosophy, ethics, sociology, history, politics, literature, art history and cultural analysis, but no course or sequence in Theology, biblical languages, scriptural exegesis, dogmatics, systematic or practical theology, or theological research. A 24-course humanities and social-science programme could examine ideas, culture and institutions around religion, but it would erase the target's defining theological formation and would not be a defensible comparison.
exception.curriculumContext: The current formal regulations account for exactly 180 ECTS: eight 7.5-ECTS courses in Year 1, eight 7.5-ECTS courses in Year 2, and a 60-ECTS third year comprising four 7.5-ECTS PThU theology courses, one 7.5-ECTS specialization, a 7.5-ECTS Thesis Seminar, 5-ECTS Science Communication and a 10-ECTS Bachelor's Thesis. The selected PThU-with-Greek pathway represents the broad theological identity of the generic target and the specialization is fixed by official order.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 rows in the current GitHub main data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx (SHA-256 7bf6c2ae9de0837086ec741c27bd94ed7e85dff2d25bde619ecd50cc4d685879), including course descriptions, outline-derived profiles, disciplines, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned availability. GOSPHIL111 Introduction to Western Philosophy, GOSPHIL212 Ethics, GOSPHIL214 Philosophy of Mind, GOSPHIL311 Philosophy of Emotion and GOSPHIL313 Free Will, Time & the Self provide philosophical and ethical inquiry. GOSHIST111 Modern History, GOSHIST211 History of Empires and GOSHIST312 History Research Seminar support historical analysis; GOSSOCI111 Introduction to Sociology, GOSSOCI214 Modern Sociology and GOSSOCI311 New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory support social analysis. MCCLITR112 Great Literary Works and MCCLITR211 World Myth & Literature engage literary and mythic traditions, while MCCHEAM111 Introduction to Western Art History and MCCHEAM212 Renaissance Italy & Global Mediterranean support cultural interpretation. None is a dedicated course in Theology, Hebrew or Koinè Greek, biblical studies, scriptural exegesis, Christian dogmatics, systematic theology, practical theology, historical theology, intercultural theology or theological ethics. The relevant UCR offerings are adjacent disciplines or occasional encounters with religious material, not a sustained theological curriculum, and cannot form an academically honest 24-course Theology closest match.
